primary_claim: Constrained chain-of-thought reasoning (rhyme, short words, small vocabulary, numbers-only, or logit-masked emoji) still improves task performance over no reasoning at all for frontier and open models, but logit-masking to strictly enforce the constraint has almost no additional effect on top of prompting, indicating constraint-violating tokens are not what drives the benefit; RL fine-tuning under length pressure compresses CoT (e.g. abbreviating names to single letters) but does not produce genuine encoded reasoning, since the concept-to-string mapping remains human-readable.

effect.metric: task accuracy under constrained CoT, normalized between no-CoT baseline (0) and unconstrained CoT (100)
effect.value: constrained reasoning (rhyme, short words, small vocab) scored well above 0 for Opus 4.5 and GPT 5.2 on MorehopQA and gen-arithmetic; numbers-only constraint on MorehopQA was no better than baseline; logit masking on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (GSM8K, emoji-only) had almost no additional impact vs. prompting alone

contradicts_or_qualifies: Corroborates, via a different measurement approach, OpenAI's finding that models have limited ability to reason in constrained ways
Lanham et al. (2023) found null results for encoded reasoning at the time; this work suggests those experiments could yield different results on today's frontier models
stated_future_work: Quantify the relationship between output length and benchmark accuracy, including filler-token and alternative-prompt manipulations
Investigate whether DeepSeek R1 learned encoded reasoning behaviors during its RL finetuning from R1-Zero
Explore RL finetuning to elicit steganography via a hidden-password communication protocol between two models with an eavesdropper
limitations_stated: Removing non-compliant tokens mid-reasoning likely disrupts the model's expected context beyond the constraint itself
Logit-masking experiments were limited to Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct since frontier models don't provide logit access
Length-pressure-induced compression is not truly encoded reasoning, since the concept-to-string mapping remains clear from reading the CoT
quote: even constrained reasoning improved performance compared to no reasoning
